items: 【Complete Garden Support Kit】This plant stakes for outdoor plants set includes 35 tomato stakes (16 inches long, 0.3 inches in diameter), 20 garden clips, 25 connectors, 15 rotating clips, 20 pointed rubber caps, 1 roll of wire, and 1 pair of gloves. These garden sticks provides reliable support for gardening and DIY plant projects

【Premium Material 】Unlike wood or metal stakes, these garden stakes for plants are made of high-quality fiberglass that won’t rot, rust, or corrode—even in damp conditions. Sturdy, durable, and reusable, the fiberglass garden stakes provide reliable support to promote healthy, upright plant growth

【Adjustable Length Design】 You can easily connect the tomato stakes and supports with included connectors to extend to 32", 48", 64", 80", or even taller. Flexible height adjustment of the plant support stakes supports plants at every growth stage—from seedlings to full harvest

【More DIY Possibilities】Easily connect the plant stakes and supports with the included connectors to create X-shaped, triangular, square, or other support structures. Secure plants firmly with rotating clips, twist ties, and garden clips—Tetutor gardening stakes garden poles ideal for both indoor and outdoor plant

【Widely Applicable】These plant support garden stakes are perfect for tomatoes, chili peppers, eggplants, beans, and more. Designed to guide plants to grow upright, The tomato plant support help improve air circulation and stability, promote healthier growth, increase yields, and protect plants from strong winds
